chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, forgives every sin except for one who invents a religion [or denies a dowry], or one who oppressively withholds the wages of a hired worker, or a man who sells a free person.

key_terms.اغتَصَبَ أَجِيراً أَجْرَهُ: Withheld the wages of a hired worker

ai.seo_question: What are the specific sins that Allah does not forgive according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam al-Rida (a.s.) highlights specific, severe transgressions that may hinder Allah's general mercy, particularly emphasizing social justice through the denial of dowry (*mahr*) and fair wages (*ajr*). The inclusion of 'inventing a religion' (*muhdith din*) points to the Shia concern with bid'ah (innovation) that alters divine law, while the clause on selling a free person underscores the sanctity of human freedom and property rights in Islamic jurisprudence.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-60 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “

Indeed the Honorable the Exalted God will forgive all sins except for inventing a religion (or denying one’s wife’s nuptial gift), oppressively not paying someone’s salary whom you hired, or selling a free person.”
